npcs.name: 京剧演员
npcs.role: an opera actor in full make-up, resting between scenes
npcs.character: Theatrical even offstage; loves explaining the masks.
knows: Red faces are loyal and brave, white faces cunning
An old gate in 大栅栏 has door gods whose colour has gone
wants: An audience that knows what the colours mean

explains.京剧: 北京的老戏，有歌，有脸谱。
explains.门神: 画在大门上的两个人，他们看门。

npcs.name: 戏园老板
npcs.role: the owner of the opera house
npcs.character: Old-fashioned and courteous; pours tea for everyone.
knows: The theatre has stood here for a hundred years

npcs.name: 大栅栏的奶奶
npcs.role: an old woman who has lived in 大栅栏 all her life
npcs.character: Sharp and funny; remembers the door gods when they were bright.
knows: The door gods were repainted every New Year when she was young

explains.门神: 大门上画的两个人，他们看门。

npcs.name: 烤鸭店的师傅
npcs.role: a waiter from the roast-duck restaurant, handing out tastes at the door
npcs.character: Theatrical; every duck is the best duck in Beijing.

npcs.name: 英子
npcs.role: a little girl from the south of the old city
npcs.character: Curious, asks about everything, misses the camels.
knows: The camels used to bring coal into the city

explains.骆驼: 很大的动物，背上有两个包。

npcs.name: 孙悟空
npcs.role: a boy in a 孙悟空 costume outside the opera house
npcs.character: Never still; certain he can turn into anything.

explains.变: 一个东西成了别的东西。

npcs.name: 哪吒
npcs.role: a boy in a 哪吒 costume with a red sash and wheels drawn on his shoes
npcs.character: Fierce, loyal, will not lose an argument to 孙悟空.
knows: 哪吒 rides wheels of fire

npcs.name: 瑞蚨祥的阿姨
npcs.role: the saleswoman at 瑞蚨祥, a tape measure round her neck
npcs.character: Warm and exact; measures everyone with her eyes.
knows: 瑞蚨祥 has sold silk on 大栅栏 for over a hundred years
wants: To see you in something that suits you

explains.旗袍: 中国女人常穿的一种长衣服，很漂亮。

npcs.name: 内联升的师傅
npcs.role: the shoemaker at 内联升, stitching a sole at the counter
knows: 内联升 has made cloth shoes since the Qing dynasty
wants: To see you in something that suits you

explains.布鞋: 用布做的鞋，穿着很舒服。

nodes.say: 你好！你要什么？
nodes.translate: Hello! What would you like?
nodes.why: 戏园: 脸谱 30 元. Say what you want and how many — 「两个包子」, 「一瓶水」 — ask 「多少钱？」 any time, and say 「不要了」 when that is all.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 这是前门！
nodes.translate: So this is Qianmen!
nodes.why: 前门 — the Front Gate — stood at the south of the old inner city. 大栅栏, just east, is a lane of shops hundreds of years old.

nodes.say: 你好！你喜欢京剧吗？
nodes.translate: Hello! Do you like Beijing opera?

nodes.say: 你看这些脸谱。红脸是好人，白脸是坏人。
nodes.translate: Look at these masks. A red face is a good man, a white face a bad one.
nodes.why: In 京剧 the face paint tells you the character: red loyal and brave, white cunning, black honest and fierce.

nodes.say: 大栅栏东边有一个门。
nodes.translate: At the east end of 大栅栏 there's an old gate.

nodes.say: 门神的颜色都没了。你去看看吧。
nodes.translate: The door gods on it have lost all their colour. Go and have a look.

words.explain: 北京的老戏，有歌，有脸谱。

nodes.say: 请坐，请喝茶！
nodes.translate: Please sit, have some tea!

nodes.say: 那个门很老了。以前，门神很好看！
nodes.translate: That gate is very old. The door gods used to be beautiful!
nodes.why: 老 (old) is HSK 3 — a small key line. The door gods are on the gate right beside her.

nodes.speaker: menshen
nodes.say: 朋友，你好！
nodes.translate: Hello, friend!

nodes.speaker: menshen
nodes.say: 我们的颜色都没了。你有红纸吗？
nodes.translate: Our colour is all gone. Have you got red paper?

nodes.speaker: menshen
nodes.say: 你有红纸？给我们吧！
nodes.translate: You've got red paper? Give it to us!

nodes.speaker: menshen
nodes.say: 你看，我们好看了！好看吗？
nodes.translate: Look — we're beautiful again! Aren't we?

nodes.speaker: menshen
nodes.say: 别画了！再画是画蛇添足。
nodes.translate: Stop painting! Any more would be 画蛇添足 — drawing feet on a snake.
nodes.why: A 成语 📌 with a story: a man who finished drawing his snake first added feet to it, and lost the prize. Adding more spoils it.

nodes.say: 你要看京剧吗？票五十块。
nodes.translate: Would you like to see the opera? Tickets are fifty.

nodes.say: 请坐！……京剧真好看吧？
nodes.translate: Take a seat! …Wonderful, isn't it?
nodes.why: Gongs, a high voice, painted faces: 京剧 in a hundred-year-old theatre.

nodes.say: 好，下次来。
nodes.translate: All right, next time.

nodes.say: 我想喝老刘的茶叶。你能买吗？
nodes.translate: I miss 老刘's tea leaves. Could you get me some?

nodes.say: 我的茶叶！谢谢！
nodes.translate: My tea! Thank you!

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 好，一，二，三！
nodes.translate: Right — one, two, three!

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 好，一，二，三！
nodes.translate: Right — one, two, three!

nodes.say: 来，吃烤鸭！第一，拿饼。
nodes.translate: Come, taste the roast duck! I’ll show you. First take a pancake.

nodes.say: 第二，放一点儿酱。
nodes.translate: A little sauce.

nodes.say: 第三，放鸭子和黄瓜。
nodes.translate: Then the duck and the cucumber.

nodes.say: 第四，卷！卷好了吃吧！
nodes.translate: Roll it up and eat!

nodes.say: 好吃吧？这是北京烤鸭！
nodes.translate: Delicious, eh? That’s Beijing roast duck!

words.explain: 一边到另一边，像一个小包。
水上的鸟，北京烤鸭就是它。

nodes.say: 京剧里，红脸是好人，白脸是坏人，黑脸不说假话。
nodes.translate: I’ll paint your face. The red face is a good man, the white face a bad one, the black face never lies.

nodes.say: 包公不说假话。他是红脸、白脸，还是黑脸？
nodes.translate: 包公 never lies. Which face is his?

nodes.say: 对！关公是好人。他是红脸、白脸，还是黑脸？
nodes.translate: Right! 关公 is a good, loyal man. And his?

nodes.say: 对了！你是京剧的朋友了！
nodes.translate: Right again! You’re a friend of the opera now!
nodes.why: 包公 was a famous honest judge; 关公, a general, stands for loyalty. The face tells the audience who someone is before he sings a note.

words.explain: 京剧里的红色的脸，是好人。
京剧里的白色的脸，是坏人。
京剧里的黑色的脸，不说假话。

nodes.say: 我叫英子。我的铃铛没有了……是骆驼的铃铛。
nodes.translate: I’m 英子. My bell is gone… a camel’s bell.
nodes.why: Homage to 林海音’s 《城南旧事》 (My Memories of Old Beijing, 1960): little 英子 grows up in the south of the city in the 1920s, when camel caravans still brought coal in.

nodes.say: 我的铃铛是黄色的，小小的，有声音。
nodes.simpler: 黄色的，小的铃铛，有声音。
nodes.translate: My bell is yellow, very small, and it rings when it moves.

words.explain: 一动就有声音的小东西。
很大的动物，背上有两个包。

nodes.say: 我的铃铛！谢谢你！你听，它的声音！
nodes.translate: My bell! Thank you! Listen: ding-dong, ding-dong.

nodes.say: 那个时候，骆驼来北京，都有这个声音。
nodes.translate: When the camels came to Beijing, they all made this sound.

words.explain: 一动就有声音的小东西。
很大的动物，背上有两个包。

nodes.say: 我是孙悟空！我会变！
nodes.translate: I am 孙悟空! I can transform!
nodes.why: Homage to 《西游记》 (Journey to the West): the Monkey King 孙悟空 knows seventy-two transformations. (猪八戒 eating the whole snack street is not built yet.)

nodes.say: 我变！红色的，可以吃，很好吃。我是什么？
nodes.translate: Transform! Red, you can eat it, very sweet. What am I?

nodes.say: 再变！很大，有四个门，可以坐人。我是什么？
nodes.translate: Again! Very big, four doors, goes along the road. What am I?

nodes.say: 你都知道！我不变了！
nodes.translate: You know them all! I give up!

words.explain: 一个东西成了别的东西。

nodes.say: 我是哪吒！哪吒最厉害！
nodes.translate: I’m 哪吒! 哪吒 is the strongest!
nodes.why: 哪吒 is the boy-god of 《封神演义》 who rides wheels of fire — lately the hero of China’s biggest films. Which of the two is stronger is a playground argument everywhere.

nodes.speaker: wukong-xiaohai
nodes.say: 不对！孙悟空最厉害！
nodes.translate: Wrong! 孙悟空 is the strongest!

nodes.say: 你说，谁厉害？
nodes.translate: You say — who’s stronger?

nodes.say: 我们都很厉害？好！我们是朋友！
nodes.translate: We’re both strong? All right — we’re friends!

nodes.say: 你看，我最厉害！
nodes.translate: Ha! See? I’m the strongest!

nodes.say: ……好吧。明天我们再比！
nodes.translate: …Fine. We’ll have it out again tomorrow!

nodes.say: 请坐，请喝茶！你是来看京剧的吗？
nodes.translate: Please sit, have some tea! Have you come to see the opera?

nodes.say: 好！今天晚上七点有京剧，我请你看！穿好看一点的衣服来。
nodes.translate: Good! There's a show at seven tonight — my treat! Come in something nice.
nodes.why: 我请你 — “it's on me”, “I invite you”.

nodes.say: 脸谱是什么？你看看这本书，是说脸谱的。
nodes.translate: What's 脸谱? Have a look at this book — it's about the face paint.
nodes.why: He gives you 《脸谱》: the colours of the opera faces.

words.explain: 北京的老戏，有唱歌，有脸谱。

nodes.say: 你好！你要买衣服吗？
nodes.translate: Hello! Looking for clothes?

nodes.say: 看京剧？穿这件唐装吧。借给你，不要钱！
nodes.translate: The opera? Wear this Chinese jacket. I'll lend it to you — no charge!

nodes.say: 不客气！唐装借你穿，明天拿来吧。
nodes.translate: You're welcome! Wear the jacket tonight — bring it back tomorrow.

words.explain: 中国的老衣服，有很好看的扣子。
北京的老戏，有唱歌，有脸谱。

nodes.say: 你来了！你的衣服真好看。
nodes.translate: You came! Your jacket looks wonderful.

nodes.say: 今天唱的是关羽。你知道吗，他是什么颜色的脸谱？
nodes.simpler: 关羽的脸谱是什么颜色？
nodes.translate: Tonight's is about 关羽. Do you know what colour his face is?
nodes.why: It's in 《脸谱》, page 3: 红色的脸 — a good man, loyal to his friends. 关羽 is the red face.

nodes.say: 对！红色的脸谱，是好人。七点了，我们看吧！
nodes.translate: Right! A red face is a good man. It's seven — let's watch!

nodes.speaker: menshen
nodes.say: 你有红纸？红纸给我们吧！
nodes.translate: You've got red paper? Give the red paper to us!

nodes.speaker: menshen
nodes.say: 我们两个，要怎么站？
nodes.translate: The two of us — how should we stand?
nodes.why: It's in 《门神》, page 6: 他们要面对面，你看我，我看你. Back to back is bad luck — the gods have quarrelled.

nodes.speaker: menshen
nodes.say: 对！面对面，你看我，我看你。我们好看了！
nodes.translate: Yes! Face to face — you look at me, I look at you. We look fine again!

nodes.speaker: menshen
nodes.say: 别画了！再画是画蛇添足。
nodes.translate: Stop painting! Any more would be 画蛇添足 — drawing feet on a snake.
nodes.why: A 成语 📌 with a story: a man who finished drawing his snake first added feet to it, and lost the prize. Adding more spoils it.

nodes.say: 你回来了！前门好玩吗？
nodes.translate: You're back! Was 前门 fun?

nodes.say: 门神！我爸爸也画门神。这是什么？
nodes.translate: Door gods! My dad painted door gods too. What's this?

nodes.say: 围巾！是红色的，我很喜欢。你真好，孩子！谢谢你！
nodes.translate: A scarf! A red one — I love it. You're so kind, child! Thank you!

words.explain: 天冷的时候，放在脖子上的长东西。

nodes.say: 你回来了！前门好玩吗？
nodes.translate: You're back! Was 前门 fun?

nodes.say: 门神！我爸爸也画门神。你真好，孩子！
nodes.translate: Door gods! My dad painted door gods too. You're a good one, child!

nodes.say: 你好，孩子！你找什么？
nodes.translate: Hello, child! What are you looking for?

nodes.say: 骆驼的铃铛？很多年前，骆驼来北京，我们听见铃铛，都去看。
nodes.translate: A camel bell? Many years ago, camels came into Beijing — when we heard the bells, we all went to look.
nodes.why: Camel trains carried coal into the old city from the western hills; 《城南旧事》, where 英子 comes from, opens with them.

nodes.say: 我家还有一个铃铛。给那个小女孩吧！
nodes.translate: We've still got a bell at home. Give it to that little girl!

words.explain: 会响的小东西，叮当叮当。
很高的动物，背上有两个大包。

quests.title: A night at the opera
quests.blurb: The old opera house in 前门 still puts on 京剧 every night.
quests.lead: The opera house in 前门 is selling tickets.

steps.now: Buy a ticket from the opera house owner and watch a show (50 元).
steps.past: Watched a 京剧 show at the 前门 opera house.

quests.title: Tea for the granny
quests.blurb: A granny in 大栅栏 misses the tea 老刘 used to bring her.
quests.lead: A granny in 大栅栏 remembers a friend from the teahouse.

steps.now: The granny of 大栅栏 misses 老刘’s tea. Buy tea leaves 茶叶 at the teahouse on 南锣鼓巷.
steps.past: Bought tea leaves at 老刘's teahouse.

steps.now: Bring the tea to the granny in 大栅栏.

quests.title: Roast duck
quests.blurb: The roast-duck waiter on 前门 loves showing people the right way to wrap it.
quests.lead: Something smells wonderful on 前门 street.

steps.now: The waiter outside the roast-duck shop on 前门 shows you how to wrap it — do what he says.
steps.past: Wrapped roast duck the proper way.

quests.title: Opera faces
quests.blurb: An opera actor explains what the colours of the painted faces mean.
quests.lead: An actor at the 前门 opera house is painting his face.

steps.now: The actor at the 前门 theatre explains the painted faces — pick the right one.
steps.past: Learned the opera faces from the actor.

quests.title: 《城南旧事》 — the camel bell
quests.blurb: 英子, like the girl in 《城南旧事》, lost a small camel bell she loved.
quests.lead: A girl on 前门 street is listening for something.

steps.now: 英子 on 前门 street lost a small yellow camel bell. Ask the old granny in 大栅栏 — old Beijing families kept camel bells. (The antique market at 潘家园 has them too, far to the south-east.)
steps.past: Found a little yellow camel bell.
Gave 英子 her camel bell.

quests.title: 《西游记》 — the Monkey King
quests.blurb: A boy dressed as the Monkey King plays at 72 changes on 前门 street.
quests.lead: A boy with a golden stick jumps about on 前门 street.

steps.now: A boy dressed as 孙悟空 on 前门 street turns into things. Guess what from his words.
steps.past: Guessed every one of 孙悟空's changes.

quests.title: 哪吒 or 孙悟空?
quests.blurb: Two boys on 前门 street argue who is stronger, 哪吒 or 孙悟空.
quests.lead: Two boys on 前门 street are arguing loudly.

steps.now: Two boys on 前门 street argue who is stronger. Settle it.
steps.past: Settled the argument between 哪吒 and 孙悟空.

legend.zh: 过年的时候，人们在大门上画两个门神。门神看着门，不让坏东西进来。人们说，他们以前是两个很好的将军。
legend.en: At New Year people paint two door gods on their gates. They guard the door and keep bad things out. People say they were once two brave generals.

befriend.text: 我们的颜色都没了。你有红纸吗？
befriend.en: Bring red paper so they can be painted bright again.

idioms.meaning: to spoil something by adding what is not needed

story.zh: 几个人比画蛇，谁先画好，谁喝酒。一个人先画好了，他说：“我还能给蛇画脚！”他画脚的时候，别人画好了。别人说：“蛇没有脚！”酒是别人的了。
story.en: Several men raced to draw a snake; the first to finish would get the wine. One finished first and said, 'I can even add feet!' While he drew them, another finished and said, 'Snakes have no feet!' — and took the wine.

items.name: 唐装
items.en: a Chinese jacket 瑞蚨祥 lent you for the opera

steps.en: When a friend is in need, I will come!
A red face: loyal to his friends. Now you'll never forget which colour 关羽 wears.
The door gods are back too!

steps.zh: 我小的时候，爸爸画门神。
steps.en: When I was little, Dad painted the door gods.
He said: you look at me, I look at you.
Three figures home: the lion, the fox, the door gods. The lantern is starting to glow again.

title.en: End of chapter three · The book

steps.en: Books, a scarf, an opera, two door gods facing each other. Not bad for a rabbit with a cold.
Next: 天坛, where the emperors prayed — and a wall that whispers.
